event_station_013@node_spine_2.quirk: Their head tilts with slow precision, like a dial being set.

shipLog.text: ◆ Arriving at station. MARV notes this is where you find out what the journey has cost you. Financially. He means financially.
◆ Seedlings in the growbay. MARV has calculated their survival odds. He is keeping the number to himself. Starting optimism is a resource.
Arrived: Nebula 1. The leg cost −3 FUEL, +2 MORALE, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
Arrived: Crossroads (The Space Version). The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
The Half-Built Relay. The captain chose “Give them the time”. Noted.
Your ship holds the girder steady while their welders walk the seam. +5 FUEL, +4 MORALE, 4 DAYS. It will not last.
Market Row. The captain chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Noted.
